description: KAPSARC Data Portal is an open data portal listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). The portal lists 1,318 datasets published by KAPSARC, an energy economics research institute in Riyadh: energy, electricity, water, transport, building and industry statistics for Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India and the world, plus economy, climate and model outputs, as tables, charts and time series with CSV, JSON and geographic exports. Coverage: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India and world aggregates, as titled per dataset. Each dataset page shows its fields, records, exports and API. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
